description: Project module for styio-view Flutter workspace, adapters, modules, runtime surfaces, and platform state.
technology_stack: Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows, and web platform runners
CMake native runner integration for desktop platforms
JavaScript/HTML/CSS prototype and Playwright screenshot tooling
Python and Bash repository, docs, and device/profile scripts
internal_components: Workspace document store, editor controller, selection, persistence, and shell state
Backend toolchain and integration adapters for local, hosted, and web execution routes
Module host, module manifests, capability matrices, staged updates, and platform visibility
Runtime replay surfaces, hosted payload codecs, debug console summaries, and graph/lane models
Prototype UI and development server security harness
Docs, product, device, and delivery gate scripts
open_source_components: Android Gradle and platform runner toolchains

resource_classes.description: Owns document snapshots, selections, revisions, persistence, file switching, and workspace document caches.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Document text copies must be tied to immutable revisions or explicit replace operations; repeated full copies require UI and memory justification.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Async loads and saves must carry generation or revision guards so stale completions cannot overwrite active state.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing documents, failed stores, and absent selections must produce explicit seed, failed, or unchanged states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Document caches and listeners must be invalidated when workspace, path, or active document changes.

state_machine.source: DocumentState, editor controller tests, workspace store tests, and shell model tests.

transitions.on: store returns existing or seeded document

invalid_operations: stale async load overwrites active document

required_tests: editor controller editing tests for document mutation
workspace document store tests for persistence behavior
shell model tests for async load or file switching changes
required_gates: cd frontend/styio_view_app && flutter test test/editor_controller_editing_test.dart test/workspace_document_store_test.dart

resource_classes.description: Owns local, hosted, and web adapter commands, execution sessions, toolchain/dependency/deployment result states, and capability routing.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Adapter payloads and hosted responses must have size limits or summarized machine payloads before buffering.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Commands must expose running, terminal, cancellation, and blocked states without overlapping writes to shared workspace state.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Unavailable routes, missing binaries, network failures, and unsupported capabilities must be normalized to blocked or failed results.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Temporary overlays, subprocesses, HTTP clients, and streams must be released after success, failure, timeout, and cancellation.

state_machine.source: Adapter result enums, execution session types, model tests, product workflow tests, and hosted/local adapter tests.

transitions.on: adapter returns failure or exception is normalized

invalid_operations: invoking adapter before route capability is checked
letting adapter exceptions escape shell model
leaving execution overlay mutable against source workspace

required_tests: adapter unit tests for touched command result type
hosted/local product workflow test when execution route changes
negative tests for timeout, missing binary, and failed response paths
required_gates: STYIO_VIEW_PRODUCT_GATE=1 cd frontend/styio_view_app && flutter test test/local_product_workflow_test.dart test/hosted_product_workflow_test.dart

resource_classes.description: Owns module manifests, capability matrices, staged updates, optional uninstall policy, platform visibility, and module enablement state.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Module manifests and capability matrices should be loaded once into stable immutable summaries unless tests justify reload behavior.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Module lifecycle changes must define staging and commit boundaries so UI reads do not observe partial updates.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing manifests, unsupported platforms, and optional modules must produce declared blocked or unavailable states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Optional uninstall and staged update cleanup must define package, cache, and data retention behavior.

state_machine.source: Module lifecycle types, manifest assets, capability matrices, module lifecycle tests, and platform runbooks.

transitions.on: platform and dependency gates allow use

required_tests: module lifecycle tests for manifest and update policy changes
capability matrix fixture test when platform visibility changes
integration gate before real package/cache deletion behavior is claimed

resource_classes.description: Owns runtime event envelopes, replay summaries, graph summaries, debug lanes, filters, and UI-facing runtime status.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Runtime event lists must be summarized or windowed before repeated UI transformations on large traces.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Runtime replay updates must preserve event order and avoid stale summaries after route changes.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Empty event streams, missing terminal nodes, and absent detail labels must have explicit empty or unknown states.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Replay windows, debug filters, and route summaries must clear or recompute when execution sessions change.

state_machine.source: Runtime summary types, runtime surface tests, hosted payload codec tests, and shell model runtime state.

transitions.on: lanes and graph details are computed

required_tests: runtime surface tests for summary and UI behavior
hosted payload codec tests for runtime event payload changes
shell model tests when execution route changes runtime state
required_gates: cd frontend/styio_view_app && flutter test test/runtime_surfaces_test.dart test/hosted_payload_codec_test.dart
